_note: Affiliate links (#1748, #1747; decision 82's money lane): one link a video, on long-form only - a Short's description links are not clickable. Rows are matched like config/playlists.json (core.playlists._matches, whole words, first row wins). An Amazon url gains tag=AFFILIATE_AMAZON_TAG; with no tag (before your Associates sign-up) no Amazon link is added at all, and whenever a link is added the FTC line is too. TapIn's GTA 6 row is an Amazon search link, not a product id nobody checked - swap in the product page once you have one. #1749 (decision 95): a row's `links` sets how many links a matching long video takes - GTA 6's two editions, Standard and Ultimate ($79.99 and $99.99 at launch), as Amazon search links. #1764: a sportsbook, pick'em or casino row is refused wherever links are built. #1760 (decision 90): a deals video - its title or topic naming Black Friday, Cyber Monday or deals - carries up to three links, matched in its title, topic and script, with one FTC line; rows marked deals_only are for a deals video alone.
